# Roof supports and headliner repair

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Clean mating surfaces, apply high-temp silicone adhesive spots, then use 4x4 posts to focus pressure while weighting the roof. [t1458]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Clean the mating surfaces between the roof support and the skin using brake cleaner to remove dirt, oil, and grime.
2. Apply a few spots of high-temperature silicone adhesive on both sides of each support rather than laying a solid bead.

_Procedure reported by [t1458]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Brake cleaner [t1458]
- High-temp silicone adhesive [t1458]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use 4x4 posts to focus pressure from ratchet straps directly over the beam in the softest part of the roof. [t1458]
- [Partial] Apply a combination of weighing the roof down and jacking up the supports simultaneously. [t1458]
